title: Cloudflare SSL on IIS
description: End-to-end SSL certificate deployment on Microsoft IIS using Cloudflare. Covers cert installation, HTTPS binding configuration, and HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect automation via PowerShell.

title: Linux → Windows file migration
description: Secure, automated file transfer from a Linux machine to a Windows Server IIS environment using SCP over OpenSSH. Part of a broader server migration workflow.

title: GitOps with FluxCD
description: Kubernetes cluster management using FluxCD for GitOps-driven deployments. Changes pushed to Git automatically reconcile with cluster state — no manual kubectl in prod.

title: Monitoring stack
description: Self-hosted observability stack using Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki. Covers metrics collection, log aggregation, and alerting — deployed in Docker with persistent storage.

title: CI/CD pipeline
description: Automated build and deployment pipelines with GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps. Includes code quality gates via SonarQube and environment-specific deployment stages.

title: This portfolio
description: Static site built with Eleventy, hosted on Cloudflare Pages with a custom domain. Includes SSL configuration, DNS management, and bot protection rules via Cloudflare Workers.
